answer: Quartz-tagged provenance chain. Each identity carries a hardware-sealed key that signs every action, and the chain records a random quartz timing offset unique to that key's manufacture. When two identities wander into overlapping activity windows, the offsets correlate—duplicates share silicon lineage, so their timing signatures match. Enforcement requires each new identity to submit to a live challenge that must complete within a fixed ocean of clock drift; cloned keys fail because their offsets diverge under load.
